wholePhysicalScope: Exact OpenStreetMap Bankova 10 ring, named house address, public original landscape and verified November 2008 frontal photograph.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the hillside frontage, entrance portico and sculptural roof silhouette. Nearer levels add recessed windows, reliefs, figures and cement cornice details.
limitations: The restored exterior is dated to November 2008. The slope and geographic footprint use original terrain and native geometry.

Roof groups and carvings are modeled with original medium-fi geometry from the documented animal and marine motifs. Individual sculptures are simplified and the hidden sides and exact opening widths are estimated.
The rendered colors use pale cement and gray roof from the documented building materials. The approved photograph uses strong night lighting, so exact daylight tint and roof fixtures are approximate.
